title: Typed exit codes for prefix and usage errors, JSON envelope for startup failures
description:
Several argument-class failures fall through to the generic exit 1, and machine-output mode emits no envelope for startup failures, so callers cannot branch on error class.

## Background

Confirmed live: ambiguous id prefix and too-short prefix exit 1 while the taxonomy reserves 2 for invalid arguments; the batch-mode description guard exits 1 while clap usage errors exit 2; dep removal applies the minimum-prefix-length check to only one of its two id arguments; repo-not-found (exit 3) and format-mismatch (exit 10) print a bare stderr line and empty stdout even in machine-output mode.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: Ambiguous-prefix and too-short-prefix errors are typed, exit 2, and carry a distinguishing code field in JSON output.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: The batch-mode description guard exits 2 like other usage errors.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: Dependency removal validates both id arguments identically.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-04: In machine-output mode, startup failures (repo not found, format mismatch) emit a structured error object on stdout while keeping their exit codes.
